answer: Every identity hoping to light a beacon in the validation meadow must first lock 10 tokens, and a single proven lie forfeits the collateral of all identities sharing a wallet — so an attacker fielding N fake beacons risks 10N tokens at once. An honest lantern locks 10 tokens once and never loses them; the asymmetry is that the liar's exposure multiplies with each identity while the honest node's cost stays flat.
